ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two cascaded 2-to-1 multiplexers. In the first MUX, the input labeled 0 is connected to logic 0, the input labeled 1 is connected to R, and the select input s is connected to P. The output of the first MUX feeds the input labeled 1 of the second MUX. In the second MUX, the input labeled 0 is connected to R̅, the input labeled 1 is connected to the first MUX output, and the select input s is connected to Q. The second MUX output is X. Reasoning: Let A be the output of the first MUX. Using the standard 2-to-1 MUX equation Y = S̅I0 + SI1, the first MUX gives A = P̅·0 + P·R = PR. For the second MUX, X = Q̅·R̅ + Q·A. Substituting A = PR gives X = Q̅R̅ + Q(PR) = Q̅R̅ + PQR. This is already the minimal sum-of-products form.

method.method_draft: Perform a case analysis on the final selector Q. In the Q=0 branch, read X directly as \(\overline{R}\), so the contributing product is \(\overline{Q}\overline{R}\). In the Q=1 branch, analyze the first mux controlled by P: it can output 1 only by selecting its R input, so P=1 and R=1, giving \(PQR\). OR the branch products and note no further combination is possible, yielding \(\overline{Q}\overline{R}+PQR\).
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有两个级联的 2-to-1 MUX。左侧 MUX 的上输入端标为 0，并接常数 0；下输入端标为 1，并接 R；其选择端 S 由 P 控制。左侧 MUX 的输出接到右侧 MUX 的下输入端 1。右侧 MUX 的上输入端 0 接的是 \overline{R}，选择端 S 由 Q 控制，右侧 MUX 输出为 X。再推理：对最终选择信号 Q 分情况。若 Q=0，右侧 MUX 选择其 0 输入，因此 X=\overline{R}，对应乘积项为 \overline{Q}\overline{R}。若 Q=1，右侧 MUX 选择来自左侧 MUX 的输出；左侧 MUX 由 P 控制，只有 P=1 时会选择 R 输入，要使输出为 1 还需 R=1，因此该分支对应 PQR。将两分支相或，得 X=\overline{Q}\overline{R}+PQR，且两项不能进一步合并。
